[SWS_PER_00541]
d
When a method of
Persistency
tries to read data from a
file
,
but the position is already at the end,
Persistency
shall return the error
kIsEof
.
c
(RS_AP_00128)
This error can typically be dealt with by the
application
, and can be avoided by
using
ara::per::ReadAccessor::IsEof
.
